method.description: Radial edge-strength profiles sampled over 1440 angular positions and compared in normalized radius space. Source-specific central overlays are treated as confounders; outer-ring matches receive greater structural weight.

interpretation: At least four outer/near-outer radial families have close normalized-radius counterparts across both sources.
The strongest normalized agreements are near ~0.38, ~0.69-0.70, ~0.86 and ~0.94 of source radius.
The two sources are not geometrically identical in their inner composition; SRC-0003 contains a major central overlay and additional rings/graphics.
Cross-source agreement supports structural-family hypotheses but does not yet define canonical ring bands or AKs.
